text:
Monzo’s UK savings rates (AER) depend on the pot type and, for variable pots, which plan you’re on. Rates below are from Monzo’s site and can change.

### Instant Access Savings Pot / Instant Access Cash ISA
Variable rate, interest paid monthly, no minimum deposit, instant withdrawals:

| Plan | Rate |
|------|------|
| Free | **2.80%** |
| Extra (£3/month) | **3.15%** |
| Perks (£9/month) | **3.55%** |
| Max (from £19/month) | **3.80%** |

### Select Access Savings Pot / Select Access Cash ISA
Higher variable rate if you make **2 or fewer withdrawals a year**. £500 minimum. Interest paid monthly. More withdrawals drop the rate until the pot’s anniversary:

| Plan | Rate (≤2 withdrawals) | Lower rate (>2 withdrawals) |
|------|------------------------|-----------------------------|
| Free / Extra | **3.45%** | **2.65%** (free); check app for Extra |
| Perks / Max | **3.70%** | **3.10%** |

### Fixed Rate Savings Pot / Fixed Rate Cash ISA
Same rates on every plan. £500 minimum. Interest paid at maturity. Early closure means you forfeit some interest (your deposit isn’t at risk):

- **1 year:** 4.70% AER (fixed)
- **2 years:** 5.10% AER (fixed)
- **3 years:** 5.25% AER (fixed)

### Other
- **Under-16s savings:** 2.80% AER (variable)
- **Savings Challenge** (1p challenge): 0% on the free plan; **5%** AER (variable) on paid plans

Cash ISA versions pay the same rates as the non-ISA pots, but interest is tax-free and counts toward your annual ISA allowance (£20,000). Eligible deposits are FSCS-protected up to £120,000 per person.

Check the latest figures in the Monzo app or on [monzo.com/savings-isas](https://monzo.com/savings-isas), as variable rates move.
